author: priya-raman
title: Idempotency-Key header on posting endpoints
body:
## What

Implements the decision in issue 233: a required `Idempotency-Key` header on every endpoint that posts to the ledger, backed by a unique constraint and a 24-hour retention window.

## How

- Middleware reads the header and looks up `(endpoint, key)` inside the request's transaction.
- First sight: handle the request, store the response, commit.
- Repeat with the same fingerprint: return the stored response.
- Repeat with a different fingerprint: 422.

## Testing

- Concurrency test with 20 parallel identical requests: exactly one posting, 19 stored responses.
- Replay of the 2026-01-09 payload pair: one posting.
- Key reuse with a different body: 422.
